Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to correctly identify the film "Name The Man" in the very first search. While the search results clearly displayed a 1924 American film titled "Name the Man!" directed by Victor Sjöström, the agent incorrectly identified the director as "Maurice Elvey" for a "British silent film 'Name the Man' (1923)" which was not the primary or most relevant result shown in the viewport. This initial error led to a chain of redundant searches focusing on the wrong director, failing to properly address the ambiguity between the two films (Elvey vs. Sjöström) that the Planner later noticed. The agent did not extract the correct information present on the screen.
